# Pilot round: grading `predicted_reasoning.md`

This note is read beside the evaluate prompt only in a pilot round of the
`predicted_reasoning_quality` grade (run-evaluate's `reasoning-pilot` and
`reasoning-pilot-merits` modes). The grade is registered: the evaluate
prompt's *Grading the forecast document* section asks for it, and that section
is the whole of the rubric. This note changes nothing it says.

A pilot round grades a sample of already-graded events again so the round's
report can read how the judges grade the forecast document; its evaluations
are uploaded with the report and never reach the ledger. Grade every candidate
exactly as the evaluate prompt asks, every field included.
